 Shop Coffee
 
 

 

 Your New Favorite Coffee Is Here From the milkshake masters at The Yard Milkshake Bar — roasted in collaboration with Haven Coffee, and now brewing in your kitchen.Peanut Butter Coffee Crunch Blend Inspired by our Peanut Butter Brownie Bliss! This bold blend delivers rich chocolate notes, roasted nuttiness, and a smooth coffee finish.Cereal Killer Blend Nostalgic, smooth, and playful. This roast captures the magic of your favorite childhood cereals—vanilla-forward with a clean, crafted taste. No added flavors, just perfectly roasted beans.Available now in limited batches!

 
 

 
 
 Shop Cookie Dough
 
 

 

 COOKIE DOUGH that is actually safe to eat rawDo you love digging into cookie dough before baking it?!?! Us too! That is why we created these yummy cookie doughs that you don’t have to worry about consuming raw. Eat it room temperature or cold to satisfy the child within and NEVER worry about getting sick from raw eggs again. We don’t have eggs in our dough and our flour is heat treated so store your dough at room temperature for up to two weeks, four weeks refrigerated or three months frozen.

 
 

 

 

 
 
 

 

 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 

 
 

 

 

 
 
 

 

 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 

 
 

 

 
 
 Shop Sprinkles The Unicow
 
 

 

 Meet Sprinkles, our adorable stuffed UniCow! With soft, plush fur, rainbow-colored mane, and signature golden horn, Sprinkles is more than just a cute addition to The Yard Milkshake Bar family—she's the ultimate snuggle buddy and a symbol of our magical milkshakes and sweet treats.

 Rainbow Unisex performance crew neck t-shirt

 

 

$30.00

 Stay cool, dry, and confident even during the most intense activities in this unisex performance crew neck t-shirt. Made from premium, moisture-wicking fabric with odor resistance, stain release, and UV protection, this shirt’s perfect for going to the gym, playing sports, hiking, or any other activity. 

• 100% premium polyester 
• Fabric weight: 4 oz/yd² (68 g/m²)
• Soft, moisture-wicking fabric
• Fade and snag resistant 
• Relaxed fit
• UPF44+ protection
• Reinforced shoulder seams
• Blank product sourced from Haiti and Mexico

Important: This product is available only in the US, except for US territories such as Puerto Rico, Guam, the US Virgin Islands, American Samoa, and Northern Mariana Islands.

Disclaimers:
• Please note that the prints on the t-shirt may have variations in texture and appearance. This is due to a natural byproduct of the printing process called glycol, a nearly-clear glossy substance that may give the print a shinier appearance where present. Glycol is water-soluble/miscible, so washing the garment will easily remove it.
• Due to the heat press used in the printing process, there may be some shading around the print area on darker-colored t-shirts. We recommend washing the garment to help mitigate any temporary color changes caused by the heat press.

This product is made especially for you as soon as you place an order, which is why it takes us a bit longer to deliver it to you. Making products on demand instead of in bulk helps reduce overproduction, so thank you for making thoughtful purchasing decisions!
